# proxmox_realm_sync (Resource)

Runs an LDAP/AD user and group sync through `POST /access/domains/{realm}/sync` and waits for the worker task. A sync is an imperative command, not stored configuration: every attribute change replaces the instance and re-runs it, and destroying it does nothing. `remove-vanished` makes a sync destructive, deleting users, groups, properties and ACLs that the directory no longer returns.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# A sync is a command, not stored configuration: changing an attribute or a
# trigger re-runs it, and destroying the resource does nothing.
# Credentials need Realm.AllocateUser on the realm and User.Modify on
# /access/groups.
resource "proxmox_realm_sync" "corp" {
  realm = proxmox_realm.ldap.realm
  scope = "both"

  # Destructive: also delete users, groups, properties and ACLs that the
  # directory no longer returns. `none` (the default) never deletes anything.
  remove_vanished = "acl;properties;entry"
  enable_new      = true

  triggers = {
    revision = "2026-11-03"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String) LDAP or AD realm to sync. Changes require replacement.
- `scope` (String) What to sync: `users`, `groups`, or `both`. Requires replacement.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when another sync is due; changing any of them re-runs the sync.

### Optional

- `dry_run` (Boolean) Only report what a sync would do without writing anything.
- `enable_new` (Boolean) Enable newly synced users immediately. The Proxmox default is `true`.
- `remove_vanished` (String) Semicolon-separated list of `acl`, `properties`, `entry` to remove when users or groups vanish from the directory, or `none`. The Proxmox default is `none`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Sync identifier (the realm name).
- `upid` (String) Worker task UPID of the last sync run.
